messages:
jess: quick design review — I pushed the new latency swimlane + time-window selector to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ

omar: looked — swimlane color scale feels low contrast at the low end. p95 line is a bit hard to pick out. can we increase p95 stroke to 2px and reduce the low-saturation band?

maria: keyboard focus for time presets is missing. tab goes into chart but skips the preset buttons. need a visible focus ring + `aria-label` for each preset button, and `aria-pressed` for the active one.

kevin: UX concern: the chart y-axis currently uses avg, but overlay and callouts are p95. users will read that wrong. either make the axis p95-normalized or show a second axis labeled `Latency (ms) — p95`.

anya: sampling control copy: label as "Sample rate" and tooltip: "Percent of requests included in heatmap (affects fidelity)". a11y suggestion: make the control a button+menu or an input with `aria-label="Sampling rate percent"`. keyboard support: left/right to adjust by 5%. small snippet: 
```
<button aria-label=\"Sample rate\" aria-describedby=\"sample-help\">25%</button>
```

samir: preference: offer a compact dropdown with common rates (1%, 5%, 10%, 25%, 100%) for precision. slider is ok for discovery but dropdown is more reliable for reproducible debugging.

design-bot: figma update published: applied 2px p95 stroke + added focus states to presets — https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ?node-id=123 (version v3.2)

jess: nice. can we add a pattern overlay option for colorblind mode for the low-density buckets? e.g., stipple or diagonal lines so low-density isn't indistinguishable from transparency. cc @maria for a11y check :thumbsup:

maria: pattern overlay works. also microcopy nit: tooltips should say 'p95 latency' instead of just 'p95'. small change but reduces ambiguity.

omar: another small one — time-window presets need a tiny inline note about sampling tradeoffs. proposed copy: 'Sampling reduces bucket fidelity; use 100% when investigating high latency incidents.'

jess: good call. I'll update the microcopy and re-upload a screenshot later today. thanks all!
